PokeR_RedHouse.title: Red house
PokeR_RedHouse.drawn: Four copies of the red house: a steep red gable roof with its ridge front to back, darker lines down its slopes and a dark red verge; white siding, a white board across the front under the tall front gable with two windows and a louvred vent in it; the red door and a window of two panes on the ground floor, a blue strip along the foot, grey corner boards.

PokeR_Shop.title: Shop
PokeR_Shop.drawn: The flat-roofed building at the right: cream walls with ochre bricks at the corners and an ochre band under the roof, three pairs of windows above and two below under red awnings, the green door with a round window between ochre pilasters; a flat roof of grey tiles inside a grey parapet, a tall red housing on it with a dark opening in its top.
